title: Require Domain Atom Source Topology
forbids: domain atom roots outside their closed schema and index surface
why: Domain atoms are small composable schema vocabularies shared across real consumers. Closing the kind prevents atoms from becoming a general helper, policy, data, or validation cabinet.
remediate: Keep index.ts and named *.schema.ts modules only; move policy, data, validation, and executable behavior to their owning kinds.
message: Domain atoms should match the positive atom blueprint spine.
